t: Crescent Tools - Brands at Ohio Power Tool
s: Crescent Tools is part of the APEX Tool Group and was founded in Jamestown, NY in 1907. They are most well-known for creating America's first open-ended adjustable wrench over a century ago, which became an essential item in most toolboxes. They continued to expand their product range to include a range of pliers, mechanics hand tools, and toolsets.
